page.notes: The symbol forms in each row are not Latin, Greek or Hebrew letters I can read with confidence, so they are marked illegible. The syllable labels and names are copied as they appear. The right-hand column of the heading row is partly visible and is copied as far as it can be read. The glyphs are pictographic symbols in a black-letter-like style, not Latin, Greek or Hebrew letters, and cannot be reproduced as text; only the printed Latin labels and column headings are transcribed. The catchword "A'ie" at the lower right is partly cut off and its reading is doubtful.
